notes.title: Hey all, we are back!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, Adriano here. 
It's been a long time since we last posted about the game.
From some of the comments we saw, some people thought we completely abandoned the game which is not true. We never wanted to stop working on this but sadly the situation was such that it forced us to take some time off from the project and resolve certain financial problems we had while finding ways to get this game back on track:
We both started working on side jobs to cover our costs of living and atm we feel like we can resume work on this project. 
Last month was spent on resolving one of the major issues we had in-game which was related to multiplayer connectivity. We didn’t post anything as we wanted to resolve that issue before making any kind of announcement. Concisely speaking, there were cases where the player was unable to connect to the server at all or the server would kick a player from the session after a successful join. After a couple of retries, the client would be completely unable to join an active session, even if the server restarted the session. This problem stumped us for quite a bit. 
It took a while to find a fix for this connectivity problem and we are confident that the fix implemented works properly enough.

Sid and I concluded that going forward, we would post an update to the game once every few months, as that would give us enough time to polish the content we add up to the game and test it out properly and we would also have time to work on our side jobs. 
Our focus over the next few updates would be on fixing most of the bugs left in-game and improving AI behavior. Once that's done, we will start adding up additional content.

Some of the people think posting the last post was something easy for me so I wanted to explain the situation.

I started this project with a love for games, and honestly, I never expected we will get so far given that I was not a professional developer: I had no experience in leading teams and everything I did on this project was me going and learning things the hard way.

The previous post was a result of me being at the point where I was extremely burnt out with the conditions at the time. This community has always kept us positive and pushed us forward to achieve better. So once again I want to thank everyone who stayed around and trusted us and gave us the opportunity to make this game.

The update with MP fixes will be pushed in a few days. We look forward to your feedback. 

Best regards 
- Adriano

Let's explain it an example

Stone pickaxe has total damage of 8, Minning efficiency of it is 0.4 which leads us to ( 0.4 * 8 = 3.2)

Iron pickaxe currently, the strongest tool, has total damage of 30 with a mining efficiency of 0.9, which leads to 27 dmg per hit.

Another new thing we added is durability on the use which is calculated opposite from efficiency 

If mining efficiency is 0.4 which we can calculate as 40%, 60% will be durability loss.

If pickaxe would have durability on use 0.25, it would be calculated as  (0.6 * 0.25 = 0.15) 

Each tool has different durability on use value depending on the material it's built of.

Using the tool in the wrong way will rapidly wear it out.

Hey everybody!

I wanted to share some info about the game and how it's coming along.

To ones who are not informed about the situation before.

The game was completely rewritten from scratch. Learning from all our mistakes and feedback we got from you.
We came close to the stage where the game was earlier so we decided to swap it out as it's way more stable and bugless.

notes.title: It's time
notes.content:
Hey guys! It's been a while since you last heard from us. For that we are sorry.
Most players are probably wondering what the game dev team was up to and it's finally time to tell you.
Sadly, due to several issues that were happening in the world, one of our team members left. 
Yes, for a small team this hit us pretty hard, but we didn't come this far just to quit easily.

We always go through and try our best to listen and act upon all the reviews, comments and feedback that you guys post. 
Most of you'll have had issues with MP or loading system to a large extent.
We had to make a good move. 

So, after much brainstorming on what to do next, we decided to scrap our entire older code base and start over. 
Yes, we agree, it was a crazy move. 
However, it was deemed as a necessity in order to move forward. 
We learned a lot from our past mistakes and this as was a way to correct everything and give players a more stable final product.

Why is this being published so late?
I didn't want to hype players, or promise something that we won't be able to deliver.
So I was waiting until we had a good and stable base with a functional loading system ready.


Finally, we would like to thank you all for the never ending feedback and support you guys have shown towards us. 
It is something indescribable and we feel like doing this is the best way to return that to the community

Best regards
- Adriano

We had few people reported that they cant harvest foliage.

It's primarily a problem with older users.


This seems to be a conflict of old saves and configs with new saves and configs. Also as Steam cloud, Syncs older saves it can cause this issue.

step 1
Turn off steam cloud on JOL game.
Go to Steam Program Files (x86)\Steam\userdata and erase folder under number 794490

step 2
Write down %appdata% into the start menu 
It should open a window. Search for Journey of Life folder and erase the whole folder.

step 3
Go to My Documents and erase Journey of Life inside My games folder.

step 4 
Run game.

If you have the same issues after doing all of this please join our Discord and we will be happy to solve out your issues.
